item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs rtsod pa bzlog pa'i 'khor lo las sgrub gzhung nyams su len pa'i mngon rtogs gsal byed sgron me
item.coloph: de ltar gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs/ khro bo rtsod pa bzlog (zlog) pa'i ting 'dzin dang / gtor ma'i mngon rtogs gsal bar byed pa/ phyi rabs gang zag blo chung gi don du/ dad ldan slob ma rnams kyi (kyis) bskul nas/ dbra btsun nam mkha' rin chen gyis sbyar ba 'dis/ 'gro rnams gsang ba sngags kyi don la rab brtson te/ mchog thun dngos grub ma lus bsnyem par shog/
